label: GO step late in the episode (trial >= ~80), when value is low
explanation: Fires essentially only at the GO step (100% of mass; never at D2, ~0 at D1), and only late in the 100-trial episode: rate per GO is ~0 before trial 40 and rises steadily to ~25% in trials 90-99 (62% of mass there). It mirrors the value head, which falls toward the end of the episode (rate 25% in the lowest value bin, 0 above value 7.7); GO & value<6.5 scores the same as the episode-time predicate (dev F1 0.63), so the two are interchangeable. Magnitude grows with episode time: the predicate covers 99% of top-quartile activations but only 51% of the lowest quartile, and in windows activation climbs trial by trial, with the biggest values at GO after an unrewarded trial near episode end. Weak secondary modulators: higher after prev_reward 0, rare previous transitions, and a2 choices (choice logit very negative). Not driven by stay/switch, the good state, or core pattern. Recorded the simple observable predicate (episode time is observable through the GRU state); adding prev_reward or value only moved F1 by ~1 point. Precision is limited (~0.55) because even late in the episode only some GO steps cross threshold.
